rules.note: Not needed to apply, but a valid passport is required if you are admitted. The programme advises having one before you apply, as interviews may involve travel.
Not listed in the official requirements.
Not uploaded at application: your transcript must show the degree conferred. You must finish your undergraduate degree by 1 August of your enrolment year and have it verified before orientation.
A scanned official transcript for each undergraduate and graduate degree you attended, showing your name, institution and degree. Not password-protected. No screenshots of grade websites.
Three letters, submitted online by your recommenders: one academic, at least one on leadership. No relatives. Emailed, mailed or applicant-uploaded letters are not accepted.
Your most recent resume or CV, maximum two pages.
Leadership Essay (750 words) and Statement of Purpose (500 words), plus two short answers of 100 words each. Going over the limits may disqualify you.
Needed unless English is your native language or you studied at least two years in English. Minimums: TOEFL iBT 100, IELTS 7, Cambridge C1/C2 185, Duolingo 130. Some tests are valid two years.
Highly recommended but not required: a short self-introduction video (about one minute) shared as an unlisted YouTube or Vimeo link.
